title: Arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi influence the speciation and subcellular abundance of uranium in plant roots
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,2394-2409
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00108K, Paper

James M. Dinsley, Kirstie Halsey, Eudri Venter, Miguel A. Gomez-Gonzalez, Katie L. Moore, Lorraine P. Field, Samuel Shaw, Clare H. Robinson, Jon K. Pittman
High-resolution elemental mapping and spectroscopy analyses of root sections from uranium-treated plants demonstrated differences in uranium particle chemical and morphological characteristics depending on the presence of mycorrhizal fungi.
